description.value: A year-round commercial campground on 4 acres in the heart of Coldstream, BC, with a creek on site and a 5-minute walk to Kalamalka Beach; free hot showers and laundry on site, though open fires are not permitted and rates apply.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content was fully fetched and provides strong evidence across multiple subpages. The /amenities page explicitly lists free hot showers, free WiFi, coin-operated laundry, ice for sale, propane tanks for rent, and several nearby food options; the /rvs page confirms municipal potable water throughout the campground; the /reservations page confirms online and phone booking. The campground's location 3 minutes from the Okanagan Rail Trail's mile marker zero and 2 minutes from Sun Country Cycle bike shop makes it directly relevant to touring cyclists.
concerns: Postal code inconsistency on website: contact/reservations pages show V1B 1Y9 while the map and footer consistently show V1B 2P4.
OSM record has no phone or address fields populated; contact details sourced entirely from website.
OSM source tag is NRCan-CanVec-7.0 (automated import); OSM node data may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Well-established year-round campground directly adjacent to the Okanagan Rail Trail mile marker zero with strong cyclist-relevant amenities; a clear fit for the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Sun Country Cycle (bike sales and rental) is listed as a 2-minute walk and Kalavida Surf Shop and Bike Rentals a 4-minute walk — useful context for touring cyclists needing repairs or rentals.

wow_evidence: free hot showers, free WiFi, coin-operated laundry… 3 minutes from the Okanagan Rail Trail's mile marker zero
